title: Create an exemption for the pod label

blocks.content:
You exempt `pod` on every metric in the current segment so recommendations skip aggregating that label. This path opens on **Configuration**.

1. Click **Add new exemption**.
2. Turn **All** on next to **Metric**. That covers every metric in the current segment.
3. In **Keep labels**, enter `pod`. You can add more labels there.
4. Leave **Disable recommendations for this metric and preserve existing rule state** off. Turning it on clears **Keep labels**.
5. Click **Save**.
**Add new exemption** is on this page. Open it when you are ready to follow the steps above.

The exemption is in the list on **Configuration**. You edit or delete it from that list.

If you choose **Exact** for one metric name, it takes effect on ingest and changes the exact-match rule. Use that when you want the unaggregated series back from now on. **Prefix** and **Suffix** take effect on recommendations, on a later cycle.

On **Metrics**, open a rule and the **Exemptions** tab to see whether an exemption affects that rule. Refer to [Create exemptions](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/create-exemptions/).
